name: Mallorca

accommodation.name: Pure Salt Port de Soller
accommodation.details: 4-star, adults only (14+). 2x Double Sea View. Breakfast included daily. Welcome drink on arrival.

vibe: All 4: Omid + Annika + Parents. Pure Salt hotel, Audi Q7, 6 nights. Parents love scenic drives, markets, villages, architecture.

weather.conditions: Hot and sunny, very low chance of rain
weather.note: Peak UV — sunscreen essential, midday shade recommended

specialNotes.title: Cap de Formentor 2026 Restriction
specialNotes.body: May 15 - Oct 18, the road to the lighthouse is closed to cars 10am-10pm. Strategy: leave by 6:30am and reach lighthouse before 10am (this requires an early start — a real sacrifice on vacation). The sleep-in-friendly alternative: take the TIB Line 334 shuttle from Port de Pollença (starts ~9:30am, runs all day). Formentor beach (Zone 1): cars allowed if 300-space lot has room — fills by 9-10am.

activities.name: Pure Salt Spa
activities.description: The hotel spa offers Mediterranean-inspired treatments. Book one afternoon session for a pool-and-spa day. Good rainy-day backup too.

restaurants.name: Ca's Patró March
restaurants.vibe: Iconic cliffside seafood on the rocks. Fresh fish, lemon, olive oil. Cash only, no mobile signal. Simple and perfect.
restaurants.bookHow: Slots open midnight online: caspatromarch.myrestoo.net — set an alarm, tables go instantly.

restaurants.name: Es Canyis
restaurants.vibe: Seafood right on the sand. Walk from Pure Salt. Easy first/last night.

restaurants.name: Agapanto
restaurants.vibe: Good cocktails, Mediterranean food, sunset views.

restaurants.name: Neni
restaurants.location: Bikini Island hotel, above Port de Soller
restaurants.vibe: Israeli/Middle Eastern rooftop with Tramuntana views. Refreshing departure from Mallorcan staples.

restaurants.name: Ca'n Pintxo
restaurants.vibe: Excellent tapas and Mallorcan dishes. Casual, lively.

restaurants.name: Kraken
restaurants.vibe: Sources fish from the market stalls that morning. Best casual seafood lunch in Palma.

restaurants.name: Ca Ses Sauerschell's
restaurants.vibe: Replaced Es Racó d'Es Teix (closed Jul 2023). Same stunning terrace overlooking the valley, more relaxed concept.

restaurants.name: Béns d'Avall
restaurants.vibe: Family-run since 1971. Best sunset dining on the island — cliff terrace above the sea. Summer: dinner only, Tue-Sat.

restaurants.name: Marc Fosh
restaurants.vibe: Farm-sourced Mediterranean in a 17th-century converted seminary. Worth it for the setting as much as the food.

bars.name: Bar Abaco
bars.vibe: 17th-century mansion, baroque decor, mountains of fruit, opera music. Theatrical. ~$19-20/cocktail. Open from 8pm. Verify before visiting — conflicting reports about current status. Call +34 971 71 49 39.

bars.name: Brassclub
bars.vibe: Award-winning mixologist Rafa Martín. Creative cocktails, sophisticated vibe. One of Palma's best.

bars.name: Agapanto
bars.vibe: Best cocktails at the port. Sunset.

bars.name: Jumeirah Sunset Lounge
bars.vibe: Clifftop sunset views, Asian-inspired tapas, local cocktails. Best sundowner spot in the port.

beaches.name: Platja d'en Repic
beaches.vibe: Sand, calm water, beach restaurants. Easy everyday beach.

beaches.name: Cala Deià
beaches.vibe: Dramatic rocky cove. Crystal water. Ca's Patró March right on it. Barrier parking — arrive before 10am in July.

beaches.name: Platja de Formentor
beaches.vibe: White sand, turquoise, pine shade. Subject to Zone 1 car restrictions (see special notes).

beaches.name: Cala Tuent
beaches.vibe: Quiet pebble cove, mountain walls, one restaurant. Uncrowded even in July.

beaches.name: Cala de Sant Vicenç
beaches.vibe: Four linked coves near Pollença. 30m visibility, great for snorkeling. Pair with Formentor day.

dayTrips.name: Deià + Valldemossa
dayTrips.highlights: Ma-10 coast road (Europe's most beautiful drives). Deià: artists' village, Cala Deià cove. Valldemossa: La Cartuja monastery (Chopin, closes 2:30pm — go morning), postcard-perfect streets.

dayTrips.name: Cap de Formentor + Pollença
dayTrips.highlights: Mallorca's dramatic northern tip. 2026 restriction: road to lighthouse closed to cars 10am-10pm. Strategy: leave by 6:30am (requires an early start) OR take TIB 334 shuttle from Pollença (~9:30am start, sleep-in-friendly). Pine Walk in Puerto Pollença, medieval walled Alcúdia.

dayTrips.name: Palma
dayTrips.highlights: La Seu cathedral (Gaudí interior, book tickets online), Bellver Castle (circular Gothic, free Sun mornings), old town courtyards, Mercat de l'Olivar (eat at the counters), Santa Catalina neighborhood. Bar Abaco for evening drinks.

dayTrips.name: Fornalutx
dayTrips.highlights: One of Spain's most beautiful villages. Stone streets, citrus groves, mountain backdrop. Coffee and a stroll. Easy half-day.

dayTrips.name: Sa Calobra + Cala Tuent
dayTrips.driveTime: Sa Calobra 50 min, Cala Tuent 45 min
dayTrips.highlights: "Road of 1,000 bends" to Sa Calobra (800m altitude change). Walk to Torrent de Pareis gorge beach. Cala Tuent: quiet mountain cove, one restaurant. Or take the boat from Port de Soller (avoids the road, adds sea drama).

dayTrips.name: Sóller town
dayTrips.highlights: Modernista architecture, covered market, Sa Fàbrica de Gelats (island's best ice cream).

bookingPriorities.how: caspatromarch.myrestoo.net — new slots at midnight, 2-3 weeks ahead
